entities.name: Abda
entities.description: A pragmatic, skeptical human monster-bonder from Ikoria, bonded with Rigi.

entities.name: Rigi
entities.description: Abda's large, badger-like monster companion, strong and loyal.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: Plane of monsters where Abda and Rigi lived.

entities.name: Brin
entities.description: A younger bonder whom Abda was protective of.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Bonder branded a deserter, who planned to approach the Ozolith; bonded with Leori.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who joined the bonders.

entities.name: Barrow
entities.description: Bonder who arrived with Zeph and endorsed Lukka's plan.

entities.name: Zeph
entities.description: Monster that arrived with Barrow in a flash of lightning.

entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: A magical structure whose influence altered monster behavior.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: City near which the bonders met.

entities.name: Vermilion
entities.description: Skyship that joined the battle and fired the projectile that killed Abda.

entities.name: Battle at the Ozolith
entities.description: Battle in which Abda and Rigi died.

events.summary: Abda and Rigi meet Brin, Lukka and Vivien Reid north of Drannith; Abda greets Lukka with hostility.
events.quote: greeted him with hostility and warned of the dangers posed by urban factions

events.summary: Barrow and Zeph arrive; Vivien says another planeswalker disturbed the Ozolith; Abda agrees to join out of loyalty to Brin.
events.quote: because of her loyalty to Brin and concern for the balance of the wilds

events.summary: Abda and Rigi fight a black serpent-like guardian nightmare at the Ozolith.
events.quote: Rigi attacked the black serpent-like monster directly

events.summary: Abda is fatally struck by a projectile from the Vermilion while assisting Brin.
events.quote: Abda was fatally struck by a projectile fired from the skyship Vermilion

events.summary: Rigi, affected by the Ozolith's pulse, destroys the hunter's longboat and helps bring down the Vermilion, dying in the process.
events.quote: Rigi destroyed the hunter's longboat and helped bring down the Vermilion by damaging its gasbag

relations.quote: Abda and Rigi were a bonded pair of monster-bonders
She showed a protective attitude toward Brin
